source.title: Sleeping Beauty transposon vector set
source.note: Vector maps reproduced from the thesis. The pT2/pT2B transposon backbones and the SB100X transposase derive from the published Sleeping Beauty system; the derived constructs are the cloning work described in the thesis.

vectors.name: pCMV(CAT)T7-SB100X
vectors.description: Helper plasmid supplying the hyperactive SB100X transposase in trans. CMV enhancer/promoter drives SB100x, with an SV40 intron and poly(A) signal; CmR backbone.

vectors.name: pT2
vectors.description: Minimal T2 transposon: IR/DR left and right flanking an empty pBluescript-style polylinker. AmpR, pUC ori and f1 ori sit outside the transposon and are not mobilised.

vectors.name: pT2 BN
vectors.description: pT2 with the modified BN cloning site between the IR/DRs — the acceptor backbone for the expression cassettes below.

vectors.name: pT2 BN SVPuro CAG EGFP
vectors.description: Transposon carrying two cassettes: SV40 promoter → PuroR for selection, and the CAG promoter (CMV enhancer + chicken β-actin promoter) → EGFP with a β-globin poly(A) signal.

vectors.name: pT2 BN SVPuro CAG KRAB
vectors.description: CAG-driven tTR-KRAB repressor — annotated as TetR with an SV40 NLS and an IRES — alongside the SV40 → PuroR selection cassette.

vectors.name: pT2 SVPuro CMV tTR
vectors.description: SV40 → PuroR selection plus a CMV enhancer/promoter driving the tet repressor (TetR), for tetracycline-controlled silencing.

vectors.name: pT2 SVNeo
vectors.description: Transposon with an SV40 → NeoR/KanR cassette, the G418-selectable counterpart to the SVPuro series.

vectors.name: pT2B Puro CMV
vectors.description: pT2B backbone with SV40 → PuroR selection and an empty CMV expression cassette ready to receive a coding sequence.
